title: Guttmann-Flury et al. 2025 (SSVEP) — Dataset combining EEG, eye-tracking, and high-speed video for ocular activity analysis across BCI paradigms
description: A multimodal dataset combining EEG, eye-tracking, and high-speed video recordings from 31 healthy participants performing a 4-class steady-state visually evoked potential (SSVEP) brain-computer interface task. The dataset comprises 3,024 trials across 63 sessions with 64-channel EEG recordings (66 total channels including EOG and stimulus) at 1000 Hz sampling rate, designed to enable analysis of ocular activity and visual processing mechanisms across BCI paradigms.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a 64-channel Neuroscan Quik-Cap (66 total channels: 64 EEG + 1 EOG + 1 stimulus) with SynAmps2 amplifier at 1000 Hz sampling rate. Participants performed a 4-class SSVEP task with flickering LED stimuli at frequencies of 10.0, 11.0, 12.0, and 13.0 Hz. Each session consisted of 48 trials with 7-second trial duration. Concurrent eye-tracking and high-speed video recordings were obtained to capture ocular activity. Reference electrode was placed at the right mastoid (M1) with ground at the forehead.
